name: incantation
description: A voice pair-programming partner for Claude Code on WSL 2. /incantation turns a session into a spoken conversation through VoiceMode: it listens at all times, never to its own voice, says each request back before it acts, and speaks only when something needs the person. It ships a guard that checks the setup is local only, a loopback proxy in front of the speech engines, a launcher for the engines, and its own listener. It needs VoiceMode installed in the same WSL 2 distribution.
